rider.zh: 騎士、騎乘者（騎馬、機車、腳踏車）

ex.en: Motorcycle riders must wear helmets.
ex.zh: 騎機車的人必須戴安全帽。

ex.en: She is an experienced horse rider.
ex.zh: 她是經驗豐富的騎馬好手。

ex.en: Bus riders will face a fare increase next month.
ex.zh: 公車乘客下個月將面臨票價調漲。

ex.en: The subway carries over two million riders a day.
ex.zh: 捷運每天載運超過兩百萬名乘客。

ex.en: The contract includes a rider on overtime pay.
ex.zh: 合約附有一條關於加班費的附加條款。

ex.en: You can add a rider to your insurance policy.
ex.zh: 你可以在保單上加保附約。

ex.en: I don't want to do anything risky.
ex.zh: 我不想做任何冒險的事。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高的利息。

ex.en: Investing all your money in one stock is risky.
ex.zh: 把所有錢都投資在一支股票上很冒險。

ex.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
ex.zh: 暴動爆發時，只有一名獄警在值班。

ex.en: Police were called in to stop the riot.
ex.zh: 警方被找來平息騷亂。

ex.en: A riot broke out after the football match.
ex.zh: 足球賽結束後爆發了暴動。

ex.en: This game got rigged.
ex.zh: 這場比賽被動了手腳。

ex.en: Many people believe the contest was rigged.
ex.zh: 很多人認為這場比賽被操縱了。

ex.en: He works on an oil rig in the North Sea.
ex.zh: 他在北海的鑽油平台工作。

ex.en: The camera rig is quite heavy.
ex.zh: 這套攝影裝備相當重。

ex.en: The company has very rigid rules about working hours.
ex.zh: 公司對上班時間的規定非常死板。

ex.en: His schedule is too rigid to change.
ex.zh: 他的行程太緊，沒辦法更動。

ex.en: He was rigid with terror.
ex.zh: 他嚇得全身僵硬。

ex.en: The box is made of rigid plastic.
ex.zh: 這個盒子是用硬塑膠做的。

rightly.zh: 正確地；有理由地、理所當然地

ex.en: You think rightly.
ex.zh: 你想得沒錯。

ex.en: As you rightly pointed out, the deadline is too tight.
ex.zh: 正如你正確指出的，期限太趕了。

ex.en: She was rightly proud of her team's work.
ex.zh: 她理所當然地為團隊的成果感到驕傲。

ex.en: All products go through rigorous testing before release.
ex.zh: 所有產品上市前都要經過嚴格測試。

ex.en: The company has a rigorous hiring process.
ex.zh: 這家公司的招募流程很嚴格。

ex.en: Her research is known for its rigorous methods.
ex.zh: 她的研究以方法嚴謹著稱。

ex.en: Due to the heavy rain, vegetable prices have risen.
ex.zh: 因為大雨，菜價上漲了。

ex.en: The cost of living in the United States was rising.
ex.zh: 美國的生活費用一直在上漲。

ex.en: The sun rises earlier in summer than in winter.
ex.zh: 夏天太陽比冬天升起得早。

ex.en: We got up early to watch the sun rise.
ex.zh: 我們早起看日出。

ex.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
ex.zh: 這項政策導致物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: Workers are asking for a pay rise.
ex.zh: 員工要求加薪。

ex.en: Such a plan will give rise to many problems.
ex.zh: 這樣的計畫會引發很多問題。

ex.en: The new policy gave rise to many complaints.
ex.zh: 新政策引起了許多抱怨。

ex.en: I was taking a bath when the telephone rang.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。

ex.en: "The phone is ringing." "I'll get it."
ex.zh: 「電話響了。」「我來接。」

ex.en: The bell has not rung yet.
ex.zh: 鈴聲還沒響。

ex.en: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!
ex.zh: 我們之間結束了，把戒指還給我！

ex.en: She wears a wedding ring.
ex.zh: 她戴著結婚戒指。

ex.en: I'll ring you as soon as I get home.
ex.zh: 我一回到家就打電話給你。

ex.en: I'll ring you back later.
ex.zh: 我晚點再回你電話。

ex.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
ex.zh: 他很有錢，卻過得像個乞丐。

ex.en: He is richer than anyone else in this town.
ex.zh: 他比鎮上其他人都有錢。

ex.en: The richest man in the world cannot buy everything.
ex.zh: 就算是世界首富也買不到所有東西。

ex.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
ex.zh: 柳橙富含維生素 C。

ex.en: Taiwan has a rich food culture.
ex.zh: 台灣有豐富的飲食文化。

ex.en: This cake is too rich for me.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕對我來說太膩了。

ex.en: The sauce is rich and creamy.
ex.zh: 這醬汁濃郁滑順。

ex.en: The boy rode a horse for the first time.
ex.zh: 那個男孩第一次騎馬。

ex.en: Tom said he wanted to try riding a unicycle.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他想試試騎單輪車。

ex.en: I ride my bike to work every day.
ex.zh: 我每天騎腳踏車上班。

ex.en: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.
ex.zh: 我兒子每次搭公車都會暈車。

ex.en: We rode the MRT to the night market.
ex.zh: 我們搭捷運去夜市。

ex.en: Do you want me to give you a ride?
ex.zh: 要不要我載你一程？

ex.en: It's a short ride from the airport to the hotel.
ex.zh: 從機場到飯店只要一小段車程。

ex.en: He surpasses his rivals in all ways.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都勝過對手。

ex.en: Don't hold your rival cheap.
ex.zh: 不要輕視你的對手。

ex.en: Our main rival lowered its prices last month.
ex.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手上個月降價了。

ex.en: He was hired away by a rival company.
ex.zh: 他被一家競爭對手公司挖角了。

ex.en: The two rival teams play each other tonight.
ex.zh: 這兩支敵對的球隊今晚交手。

ex.en: Few cities can rival Paris for its food.
ex.zh: 論美食，很少有城市比得上巴黎。

ex.en: The new phone rivals much more expensive models.
ex.zh: 這支新手機可以媲美貴得多的機型。

rid.zh: get rid of：擺脫、丟掉、除掉

ex.en: We got rid of the mice in their house.
ex.zh: 我們幫他們除掉了家裡的老鼠。

ex.en: I need to get rid of some old clothes.
ex.zh: 我得把一些舊衣服處理掉。

rid.zh: 使擺脫、清除（rid A of B）

ex.en: The new software will rid us of these errors.
ex.zh: 新軟體能讓我們擺脫這些錯誤。

ex.en: We want to rid the office of paper waste.
ex.zh: 我們想消除辦公室的紙張浪費。

ex.en: I'd like mapo tofu, and two bowls of rice.
ex.zh: 我要一份麻婆豆腐和兩碗白飯。

ex.en: Can I have seconds on rice and cabbage?
ex.zh: 我可以再來一份飯和高麗菜嗎？

ex.en: This year promises a good harvest of rice.
ex.zh: 今年稻米可望豐收。

ex.en: A festival is held at the rice harvest.
ex.zh: 稻子收成時會舉辦祭典。

ex.en: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
ex.zh: 把他們所有的錢都花光太荒謬了。

ex.en: Such a ridiculous superstition no longer exists.
ex.zh: 這種荒謬的迷信已經不存在了。

ex.en: You're just being ridiculous.
ex.zh: 你真是太誇張了。

ex.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
ex.zh: 這條法律會剝奪我們的基本權利。

ex.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
ex.zh: 基本人權當然應該受到尊重。

ex.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ex.zh: 這間房子看起來不錯，而且價格也合理。

ex.en: You're right. I made a mistake.
ex.zh: 你說得對，我錯了。

ex.en: You have your right sock on wrong side out.
ex.zh: 你右腳的襪子穿反了。

ex.en: Turn right at the corner.
ex.zh: 在轉角右轉。

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我朋友現在正在電話上。

ex.en: I'll be right back.
ex.zh: 我馬上回來。

ex.en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
ex.zh: 莊嚴的寺廟裡舉行了一場神聖的儀式。

ex.en: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
ex.zh: 燔柴祭天是一種古老的祭祀儀式。

ex.en: The sky cleared up after the ritual was over.
ex.zh: 祭祀結束後，天就放晴了。

ex.en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
ex.zh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。

ex.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河對小孩來說游泳很危險。

ex.en: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨讓河水氾濫。

ex.en: In order to do that, you have to take risks.
ex.zh: 要這麼做，你需要冒險。

ex.en: I don't want to run such a risk.
ex.zh: 我不想冒這個險。

ex.en: One who doesn't take risks will not win.
ex.zh: 不冒險就不會贏。

ex.en: He risked losing all his fortune.
ex.zh: 他冒著失去所有財產的危險。

ex.en: I know what you've risked.
ex.zh: 我知道你冒了多大的風險。
